information: ### Important Guidelines for SABA Cube Open 2024: **Arrive Early!** Please ensure you are at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late arrivals won't be allowed to participate, so be punctual! **New to WCA Competitions?** If this is your first WCA competition or you're unfamiliar with the rules, attend the tutorial session. It’s crucial to ensure you’re well-prepared. **Don't Forget Your ID!** First-time WCA competitors must bring a valid Government issued ID card for verification at the event. Happy Cubing!
